slides.title: A *10-minute break is part of the *work.
slides.body: 5 rules for breaks that actually refill you.

slides.title: Stop on *purpose.
slides.body: End the block when you planned to, not when you are empty.

slides.title: *10 minutes or less is *enough.
slides.body: A 2022 research review: short breaks lifted energy and cut fatigue.

slides.title: Leave the *screen.
slides.body: Window, water, a lap of the room. Eyes off the work.

slides.title: Scrolling is *not a break.
slides.body: Your eyes and your head are still on a screen.

slides.title: Set the *end time first.
slides.body: Decide when you are back before you get up.

slides.title: Rest is how the next block *works.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
